rationale: This is a pure horizon/smoothing knob on the archive's `cash_coverage_of_required_investment` (identical numerator, denominator, floor, and winsorization, only summed over three years), exactly the kind of cosmetic variant the objective warns against, and it will be highly correlated with the original rather than a distinguishable test.

The construction is structurally identical to the archive's `margin_up_capex_down_divergence` (rank of 5-year profitability trend minus rank of 5-year capex-intensity trend) with only input substitutions (oancf for oibdp, at for ppent), so it is an input swap on an already-evaluated design rather than a new mechanism, and the two trend series will be strongly correlated.

The within-firm capex-versus-own-norm leg is a genuinely new, continuous construct that is not spanned by cross-sectional CMA/asset-growth, the diagnosis of why the earlier TS_RANK version failed is credible, and the profitability leg is measured consistently with the archive's better performers — though the reviewer should verify MA(capx,5) does not include the contemporaneous capx in a way that mechanically compresses dispersion.

The working-capital investment channel is economically distinct from everything in the archive and reacts on a shorter cycle, but the inventory-growth-minus-sales-growth leg is itself a well-documented fundamental-analysis signal (Lev–Thiagarajan, Abarbanell–Bushee, Thomas–Zhang), so the incremental content rests entirely on the interaction with persistent cash profitability.

GROWTH(oiadp) is ill-defined when base-year operating income is negative or near zero, which makes the cross-sectional rank of the first leg partly noise-driven for a nontrivial share of firms, and the resulting construct is close to a coarse change-in-return-on-capital measure already spanned by profitability-growth/expected-growth factors.

The hypothesis is internally inconsistent — it argues R&D is a discretionary *investment*, which implies it belongs in the denominator (investment requirement), yet the expression adds it only to the numerator — so the signal mechanically becomes coverage plus R&D-intensity-scaled-by-capex and will load on the known R&D-intensity anomaly rather than testing the stated mismeasurement channel.
